channel.title: Thoughts, Poetry & Stories — Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad
channel.description: Technical articles, poetry, and Bengali creative writing by Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad.

item.title: Designing Privacy-Aware Access Control for CampusNet
item.description: A proposal-based look at combining verified academic identity, role-based permissions, and field-level privacy in a multi-university platform.
item.author: mdiftiurhossenriyad@gmail.com (Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad)

item.title: Beyond the SOS Button: Designing a Secure Incident Lifecycle
item.description: How a proposed emergency coordination platform can make incident verification, assignment, status updates, and closure safer and more accountable.
item.author: mdiftiurhossenriyad@gmail.com (Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad)

item.title: Building Secure RAG AI Assistants
item.description: How I designed IR Prohori using RAG, Chroma Vector DB, and prompt grounding to deliver bilingual cyber safety guidance in Bengali for Bangladeshi youth.
item.author: mdiftiurhossenriyad@gmail.com (Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad)

item.title: Understanding Intrusion Detection Systems
item.description: A beginner's guide to IDS: signature-based vs anomaly-based detection, and how I built ThreatGuard as a lightweight IDS architecture using C++.
item.author: mdiftiurhossenriyad@gmail.com (Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad)

item.title: My Journey into Cyber Security
item.description: From a curious student to Founder of MyGenie — the tools, mindset, and lessons that shaped my path into offensive and defensive security research.
item.author: mdiftiurhossenriyad@gmail.com (Md Iftiur Hossen Riyad)
